sn46.49:1.1: Ajjhattikam bhikkhave aṅgan ti karitvā nāññam ekaṅgam pi samanupassāmi sattannam bojjhaṅgānam uppādāya || yathayidam bhikkhave yonisomanasikāro || || 3.
sn46.49:1.2: Yonisomanasikarasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pātikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati- bahulīkarissati || ||
sn46.49:1.3: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn46.49:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la-pe ||
sn46.49:1.5: upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || 5.
sn46.49:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikārasampanno sattabojjhaṅge bhāveti || satta bojjhaṅge bahulī karotī
